newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel eases with futures, good availability.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel eases with futures, good availability.

text.p: NWE jet fuel fell on Monday in line with hefty losses in benchmark IPE gas oil futures and perception of fairly healthy supplies, traders said.
June IPE gas oil shed $4.25 to close at $161.00 a tonne.
Traders said premiums were slightly under pressure from fairly good availability.
They assessed barge premiums at around June gas oil $16.50/+$17.50 tonne fob ARA.
"If you want material it's available and what with the futures coming off the whole thing is pretty weak," said one trader.
